correctness.rationale: Complete transition-count proof: four unary maximal runs, precisely parameterized two-transition unary-border families with one boundary exclusion each, one three-transition mixed-border interval. No other transitions possible. Indicator count, universal bound and explicit all-spectrum constructions follow arithmetically. Exact endpoint sets compared to literal closedness for all 4096 quadruples in [1,8]^4, plus all fixed-length attainable spectra n=4..32. Finite checks corroborate and do not substitute for the all-parameter proof.
